ROOT.functiondef: CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODPelnyNumerDokumentu ( @gidtyp integer, @numer integer, @miesiac integer, @rok integer, @seria varchar(10), @krotkinumer tinyint) RETURNS varchar(35) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Ret varchar(35); DECLARE @DocName varchar(30); DECLARE @Format varchar(30); DECLARE @Sep2 char(1); SET @Format=(SELECT Kon_Wartosc FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer=992); SET @DocName='' SET @DocName=CASE @gidtyp WHEN 2001 THEN 'WZ' WHEN 2009 THEN 'WZK' WHEN 2033 THEN 'FS' WHEN 2041 THEN 'FSK' WHEN 960 THEN 'ZS' WHEN 1152 THEN 'ZZ' WHEN 1489 THEN 'PZ' ELSE CAST(@gidtyp as varchar(10)) END SET @Sep2= substring(@Format,4,1) SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'1','@1') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'2','@2') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'3','@3') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'4','@4') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'5','@5') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'6','@6') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'7','@7') SET @Ret=@DocName+@Format SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@1',CAST(@numer as varchar)) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@2',REPLACE(isnull(SPACE(8-LEN(cast(@numer as Varchar))),'') + cast(@numer as Varchar) ,' ','0')) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@3',RIGHT(cast(@rok as Varchar),2)) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@4',CAST(@rok as varchar)) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,case when rtrim(ltrim(@seria))='' and charindex(@Sep2+'@5',@ret)>0 then @Sep2+'@5' when rtrim(ltrim(@seria))='' and charindex('@5'+@Sep2,@ret)>0 then '@5'+@Sep2 else '@5' end,RTRIM(@seria)) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@6',RIGHT(CAST(@miesiac as varchar),2)) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@7',CASE WHEN @miesiac < 10 THEN '0'+RIGHT(CAST(@miesiac as varchar),2) ELSE RIGHT(CAST(@miesiac as varchar),2) END) if len(rtrim(ltrim(@Ret)))>16 and @krotkinumer > 0 begin SET @Ret = substring(rtrim(ltrim(@Ret)),1,15)+'*' end RETURN @Ret END
